## About
Dependable All Pro is based in Elizabeth and works on homes and commercial properties all over New Jersey. Roofing comes first, from new roofs to repairs and maintenance, along with siding, gutters, skylights and power vents.
Our customers usually know us as Santos and his crew. One customer had us replace her mom's roof in the heat of July. Another called after a storm tore shingles off. We show up on time, explain what we're doing, and leave the place clean.
We're rated 5 on Google from 41 reviews, and we'd like to earn yours.

## Services
- Roofing Services: New roofs, repairs, replacements and maintenance for residential and commercial properties, in shingle and shake.
- Siding Services: Siding installation for homes and businesses, with options in vinyl, wood or fiber cement.
- Gutter Services: Gutter installation and repair to keep water away from your foundation, siding and landscaping, including seamless gutter systems.
- Skylight Services: Skylight installation, from traditional fixed skylights to motorized venting skylights.
- Power Vent Services: Power vent installation to help regulate temperature and moisture in your attic.
- Windows Services: Window work as part of your exterior project. Just mention it when you get in touch.

## FAQ
Q: Do you give free estimates?
A: Yes. Get in touch and we'll set up a free consultation to look at the job and give you a quote.

Q: When can I reach you?
A: We're open 24 hours, Monday through Sunday, and available around the clock by e-mail and text.

Q: What areas do you cover?
A: We're based in Elizabeth and work across Northern, Central and South Jersey, including Union, Essex, Middlesex, Monmouth, Ocean, Burlington, Mercer, Somerset, Hunterdon, Warren, Morris, Passaic and Sussex counties.

Q: What kinds of siding do you install?
A: We install vinyl, wood and fiber cement siding, and we'll help you pick what suits your style and budget.
